verdict: Chipotle grew revenue 9.3% to $3.3B as comparable sales rose 2.2% with traffic positive again, and it raised full-year comp guidance — but profit fell 7% to $404M as food, labor and legal costs climbed.

kpis.label: Restaurant-level margin
kpis.note: of revenue, at the store level

segments.name: Food and beverage revenue
segments.note: Burritos, bowls and drinks across 4,186 company-owned restaurants. Digital orders were 38.3% of this revenue, and 100 new restaurants opened in the quarter — 80 of them with a Chipotlane drive-thru.

segments.name: Delivery service revenue
segments.note: Delivery fees Chipotle collects on orders placed through its own app and website — a sliver next to the food itself.

flow.costPlain: Everything it costs to run the restaurants themselves: food, beverage and packaging ($994M), crew labor ($836M), occupancy ($174M) and other operating costs ($500M).

opex.name: General and administrative
opex.note: Running the company above the restaurant level — headquarters, marketing and support, including a $10M legal reserve this quarter.

opex.name: Depreciation and amortization
opex.note: Spreading the cost of restaurant build-outs, equipment and technology.

opex.name: Pre-opening costs
opex.note: Costs to open new restaurants before they serve their first burrito bowl.

opex.name: Impairment and closure costs
opex.note: Writing down or closing underperforming locations, and disposing of assets.

follow100Note: Three-quarters of every $100 never leaves the restaurant — ingredients, crew and rent eat it on site. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: Traffic improved again
takeaways.text: Comparable sales rose 2.2% — transactions up 1.0% and average check up 1.2% — a second straight quarter of improving transaction comps. Digital sales climbed to 38.3% of food and beverage revenue.

takeaways.title: 100 new restaurants, guidance raised
takeaways.text: Chipotle opened 100 company-owned restaurants (80 with a Chipotlane) plus one partner-operated abroad, passing 4,200 total locations. Management raised full-year guidance to low-single-digit comparable sales growth and 350–370 openings.

takeaways.title: Margins squeezed at the restaurant
takeaways.text: Restaurant-level margin fell to 25.2% from 27.4% as food, beverage and packaging costs rose to 29.7% of revenue (beef and freight inflation) and labor rose to 25.0%. Operating margin fell to 15.7% from 18.2%.

oneTimers: Adjusted net income of $418.9M excludes $18.2M of items: a $10.0M legal reserve in G&A, $3.9M of restaurant asset impairment, $3.3M of Recipe for Growth restructuring costs and $0.9M of retention stock pay.
Chipotle repurchased $630.7M of its own stock in the quarter at an average of $32.55, and the board added $1.3B of buyback authorization; $1.7B remained at June 30.
otherDetail: Interest and other income, net, was $7.7M — mostly interest earned on Chipotle's cash and investments.
footerNote: Chipotle doesn't report gross profit; the middle step is its own 'restaurant-level operating profit' — revenue minus the four costs of running the restaurants.
